==English==

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|la|mēnsis||month}}, the plural being {{m|la|mēnsēs||months}}, corresponding to the approximately month-long span of the menstrual cycle. Compare {{m|en|month}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɛn.siːz/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-menses.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|p}}

# The [[discharge]] of [[blood]] and [[cellular]] [[tissue]] that [[flow]]s from the [[inner]] [[lining]] of the [[uterus]] out through the [[vagina]], occurring typically once a [[month]] in [[uninseminated]] [[women]]; a [[menstrual]] flow.

====Synonyms====
* ''See'' [[Thesaurus:menstruation]].
